title: How the Layer Rate per 1,000 Is Derived for an Excess Flood Limit Increase
content:
**Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** — the layer rate per 1,000 at which the added limit of an increase is charged.

## Rule

The layer rate per 1,000 for an increase is found by the method the booked term premium calls for: where the term premium booked for the current term is at or below the tier's minimum premium, it is the tier's dwelling rate per 1,000 times the zone factor that the tier's zone factor table gives the flood zone on the policy record; where it is above the minimum and the policy carries excess personal property, it is the booked term premium less the tier's loss-of-use charge, times the share the scheduled dwelling charge makes of the scheduled dwelling and personal property charges together, divided by the excess dwelling limit in thousands; and where it is above the minimum with no excess personal property, it is the booked term premium less the tier's loss-of-use charge, divided by the excess dwelling limit in thousands.

The scheduled dwelling charge is the excess dwelling limit divided by 1,000 times the tier's dwelling rate per 1,000, and the scheduled personal property charge is the excess personal property limit divided by 1,000 times the tier's personal property rate per 1,000. The booked term premium is the latest term premium item booked for the current term, or the term premium on the policy record where no term premium item is booked for that term. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

| Flood zone on the policy record | Zone factor |
|---|---|
| X, B or C | 0.3 |
| A99 or AR | 0.6 |
| AO | 0.9 |
| D | 1.2 |
| V or VE | 2.75 |
| A, AE, AH and any other zone | 1.0 |

## Method by case (hypothetical figures, not a tier's: dwelling rate 2.00, personal property rate 3.00, loss-of-use charge 100.00, minimum premium 500.00)

| Booked term premium | Excess limits | Layer rate per 1,000 |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00, at the minimum; zone AO | any | 2.00 times 0.9, that is 1.80 |
| 1500.00 | dwelling 700000, personal property 200000 | scheduled charges 1400.00 and 600.00, dwelling share 0.7; 1400.00 times 0.7 divided by 700, that is 1.40 |
| 1500.00 | dwelling 700000, no personal property | 1400.00 divided by 700, that is 2.00 |
